currentState: Issue 1 compiled; ten-title progression is a provisional curriculum map, not a ten-issue commitment.
issueCountPolicy: Academy course architecture: default one issue; use two or three only if the source material and dramatic form genuinely require additional room. Three total issues is the expected maximum. Legacy multi-module plans are content pools, not issue assignments.

sourceFamilies.name: Shattering failure record
sourceFamilies.use: Timing drift, echo-lag, harmonic bowing, tearing, duplicate silhouettes, anchor/reference failure.

sourceFamilies.name: Physics Crosswalk
sourceFamilies.use: Test possible reciprocal-field interpretations without converting hypotheses into historical fact.

sourceFamilies.name: Current Mirrorfold/corridor science
sourceFamilies.use: Shared measurement vocabulary and known limits.

teachingRule: Classification is a working model, not an answer. Source captions should often present an observation first; the classroom must decide what it proves.

productionIsolation.cast: course-local by default; cross-course reuse must be explicit
productionIsolation.imgProject: dedicated course IMG/reference project when visual production begins
productionIsolation.gitWorkflow: develop on a course-specific feature branch when useful, then merge approved state to main; do not treat a long-lived branch as separate canon
